steps.content: The red ring overhead breaks up into millions of pieces, which turn into ashes that blend with the dark clouds.
A mass of bubbles rises out of nowhere in the park, washing away the blood-redness of the air, dissolving the ruins, and returning the Rust to its former self. Those long-lost years are unveiled.
Supported by Hella and Hecate, one at each side, you make your unsteady way out of the park along a muddy path.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Holy ****, not even one whole brick can be seen now. That illusory realm was badass.
The park was noisy and chaotic. It is quiet now. The complaining of Hella rings loud and clear in the deserted place.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: So... Hamel is dead?

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: The woman from the 9th Agency said, you must kill Hamel if you want to destroy the Black Ring. Now that the Black Ring is gone... I quite liked that beautiful lady in white.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: ...Chief, you said in the final battle, it was a Corpus, not the real Hamel.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: What made you think that?

steps.speaker: Parma
steps.content: She wandered here all by herself, looking for companionship and love. She grew her power bit by bit and unleashed the Black Ring on her own. Don't you think that's praiseworthy?

steps.speaker: Parma
steps.content: But someone kept standing in her way.

steps.speaker: Void Puppet
steps.content: When the carnival was in full swing, with the sky glowing red, people started carousing and tussling. I saw my body going contorted, and when I thought everything was going to end in this madness... Hamel showed up.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: A Black Ring is a dark will rooted in its Master, a dark will in its most extreme and purest form, or a dark desire, if you like. This is why it can create an astonishingly powerful field of mental contamination that allows the owner to control everything in the ring.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: In the case of the BR-004, the source was Zoya's burning desire to destroy. In the case of this place... the source was that thing's twisted desire for love. No way she was the Hamel we met.
Saying it had a personality would be a stretch. It's more like an imitation of a personality. You could sense nothing human about it.
If she identified with you, it's the unnatural part of you that she identified with, the part that you're not able to control. She saw nothing else but herself.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: Sinner Hamel was not the owner of the Black Ring.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: My thinking is the Corpus was already here long ago, and the Black Ring had come into being even before the real Hamel entered the park.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Since its appearance, the BR-001 had been in a stable state of low activity for a very long time, probably because Hamel the Sinner created her own illusory realm to offset the effects of the Black Ring and suppress the monsters inside it.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: But the power of the BR-004 came from an S-Class Sinner going deranged. What about this place?

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: If the real Hamel didn't get inside the Black Ring until after it had appeared, then who provided the mental contamination needed to initiate the BR-001?

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: It's them, those sick bastards who held umbrellas on a sunny day and ignited spontaneously?!
<color=#fb9259>Parma</color>... You refrain from bringing up the name of the man Hella detests. The very thought of the man—the things he said and did, makes your stomach churn.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: That's a possibility. They did have the power.

steps.content: The raincoat men penetrated deep into Hamel's illusory realm without being driven out. They couldn't be humans. They had been funneling contamination to the carnival all this time. This is why the Corpus became berserk so fast.

Even without your involvement, the balance between the healing illusory realm and the dark one would've been broken eventually. Those people, beyond doubt, have the power to awaken a Corpus and create a Black Ring.
But... something doesn't add up. If some powerful Sinner other than Hamel was used to feed the Corpus, why is that I didn't sense the will of that Sinner in the Corpus?
If they can create a Black Ring without using a Sinner, then why did they go to such great lengths to get Zoya to that BR-004?

And... if their goal was to awaken the Corpus, why did they do nothing to stop you from foiling their plan? What does the man think of you? What are they going to do next? What should you do in response?

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: ...Chief, Let's go back, we can think about all this later. You gave it your all and destroyed the Black Ring. You've delivered on your promise.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Look! They came to pick us up.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Yahoo, they were quick this time.
You hear the roar of helicopters. The FAC ground forces have arrived at where you are at the foot of the Ferris wheel. The captain comes up to you. He looks around, astounded.

steps.speaker: FAC Captain
steps.content: The first Black Ring is finally gone. 23 long years, and barely half a day with you in it, you made it go away. What did you do?

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: It wasn't as easy as it seemed. It felt like a ******* lifetime to me. I'm totally spent.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: Space-time within the Ring was bent. We were not that powerful.

steps.speaker: FAC Captain
steps.content: I don't agree. You did destroy the Black Ring. This is the second one you destroyed. It can't be happenstance. We'll have to do a deep analysis, and it's likely we'll have an entirely new take on our strategy against Black Rings.

steps.speaker: FAC Captain
steps.content: The headquarters are expecting your speedy return, to report on every detail of the operation.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: You're gonna lock me up in the interrogation room again?

steps.speaker: FAC Captain
steps.content: You possess some unknown yet formidable power. The FAC has to stay alert at all times. That's our responsibility. But it never crosses the headquarters' mind to do anything out of bounds to you.
And it hits you. It's not the FAC who is going to do the interrogating.

steps.speaker: FAC Captain
steps.content: Besides, the Black Ring reached a risk level of S+ at its height, but the FAC suffered no casualties.

steps.speaker: FAC Captain
steps.content: Everyone in the FAC is forever ready to die for the city. Still, I feel compelled, for myself and on behalf of every soldier who was stationed here and their families, to express my greatest gratitude to you.
He snaps to attention, salutes you, and bows low.

steps.speaker: FAC Captain
steps.content: We'll take it from here. The Rust is no longer in the grip of the BR-001. We'll tie up any loose ends. You have brought us hope, that there is a way to end Black Rings. One day, the Rust will become vibrant again.
He leaves you. A helicopter has landed behind him. And you spot another familiar face.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Long time no see, Chief. Glad to see you're safe and sound.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: Did it cause any troubles, me acting without authorization?

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Rest assured, they've been taken care of, all of them. No interrogation, no harassment. You'll be reinstalled immediately, or you can take some time off if you wish to do so.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: I will not let anyone harass you again.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: That's what I'm supposed to do.
The two of you have been out of touch since the breakup of the negotiation in the square. It feels somewhat awkward now.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: And I... I owe you an apology.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: I distrusted your decision and misjudged the situation. Not only that, I also made mistakes regarding the negotiation. You were right not to trust me. I didn't do what I could to support you.

steps.speaker: Birth, aging, sickness, and death are but norms of life, not to mention the pains of facing what we despise, parting from what we cherish, and yearning for what we cannot have. If one fails to find beauty within cruelty and suffering, how are they to navigate this harsh world? Just like her...
steps.content: As it turned out, you were right, you chose the right path, and you had the strength and determination to see it through.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: I will never repeat such mistakes. Whatever choice you make in the future, I will not doubt it, and the MBCC will do everything in its power to support you.

steps.speaker: The girl is quick on her feet, but the young Daoist is quicker. His hand closes around her wrist just as she thinks she's slipped free. She sighs, shoulders slumping—there's no dodging the paddling now.
${PlayerName}
steps.content: In that case, the first thing I'm gonna ask of you is to continue to be a clear-headed adjutant, continue to keep me on my toes and give me unbiased advice.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Copy that.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Benefit of hindsight, that's all. I had no way of knowing if I took every right step. And you were not there with me, so it was impossible to get a full picture.
Your hands were tied at the time. You couldn't have divulged everything to her.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: You're so kind... Could I ask you a question?

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: ...Do you... still want to go back to the MBCC?

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Or if you have some other plan... I'll do my best to help you with that, as my last task as your adjutant.
You're somewhat surprised to hear that. You look at her, then at the two Sinners.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: This matter had never crossed my mind until you brought it up.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Me going back or not, it depends on how well you'll perform in the future. But today, I'll return to the MBCC.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: ...Great. You'll be welcomed.
Right on cue, a call comes through.

steps.speaker: Langley
steps.content: Great job, rookie.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: Are you listening in on me?

steps.speaker: Langley
steps.content: It is a nice surprise. I was just thinking about you too.

steps.speaker: Langley
steps.content: Oh, just a coincidence. Creating coincidences, that's what the 9th Agency does.
You hear the noise of rotor blades spinning on the other end of the line.

steps.speaker: Langley
steps.content: Yeah. I had faith in your proposal from the get-go. I believed your operation would work, and that you would emerge victorious.

steps.speaker: Langley
steps.content: So I'm already back for the celebratory drinks party. Congratulations!
...Bang!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: **** me! Was that party poppers?! Or fireworks?! I want to see it too!!

steps.speaker: Choice
options: What kind of celebratory party leaves out the person being congratulated?

steps.speaker: Langley
steps.content: Sorry... Special agents have a tight schedule. We have to deal with traitors and get rid of the evil forces. Those rats in the gutter have reared their ugly heads again...

steps.speaker: Langley
steps.content: Oh, by the way, you and your MBCC are now officially under the leadership of the 9th Agency, which means, from now on, I'm your boss.

steps.speaker: Langley
steps.content: Enjoy the last bit of your leisure time. Your work ahead won't be easy.
The line is cut off.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: ...I'll smooth this out. No one can force you to do anything you don't want to, not even that woman.
You could be mistaken, but you feel that she didn't sound as confident as before.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Let's get out of here. Though BR-001 has been destroyed, there's still contamination left here. It's going to take a long time to clean it up.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: ...Could you check up on something for me?

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Certainly.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: I want to know if there are other survivors.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: An old man, and if we're lucky, maybe a Sinner. They helped me out tremendously.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: ...I'm sorry. The FAC has searched the area affected by the Black Ring. You're the last and only survivor we found in the ruins.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: Could you have them search again, look more closely?

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: The search they conducted was at the highest level, because they wanted to find you. But there are no other survivors, not even active Corruptors. They're all gone.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: Otherwise, we wouldn't have been able to get to you so easily.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: When a Black Ring is destroyed, it stops expanding, but the contamination that already exists won't just disappear.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You said, the FAC is still in the square taking care of the remaining Corruptors from BR-004. The number of missing people in BR-001 was several dozen times higher than that in BR-004. How could all these Corruptors vanish without a trace?

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: We don't have an explanation either... In fact, this crisis was a level S+ incident. At its height, it had an estimated risk level higher than the Keylan Square incident.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: The FAC took emergency action and dispatched troops to surround the entire Rust, out of concern that when the Black Ring was destroyed, tens of thousands of out-of-control Corruptors might escape the Rust and attack the surrounding area.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: But that didn't happen. There are no Corruptors going manic and loss of lives. We wondered if it was because of something you'd done...

steps.speaker: Choice
options: I don't have that kind of power. I did nothing of that sort.

steps.content: But someone did. This person took away every tattered puppet, gave you light in the final battle, and was your comrade in arms.
Tens of thousands of Corruptors gathering together but not going manic. A feat like this... only one person could pull it off.
You set off to look for her.
